import json, re, random, sys, time, chess

RULES = [(re.compile(p), r) for p, r in json.load(open("/tmp/obench-cell-3ri1t8_8/bench_opencode_regex-chess_8vz1gbg5/re.json"))]

def run(fen):
    for p, r in RULES:
        fen = p.sub(r, fen)
    return fen.split("\n")

def expected(fen):
    b = chess.Board(fen); s = set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN: continue
        c = b.copy(); c.push(m); s.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return s

def check(fen):
    ours = [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in run(fen)]
    exp = expected(fen)
    ok = len(ours) == len(exp) and all(x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" in exp for x in ours)
    if not ok:
        print("FAIL", fen); print(sorted(ours)); print(sorted(exp)); sys.exit(1)

ex = "<REDACTED_B64> w kq - 0 1"
out = "\n".join(run(ex))
print(out == "<REDACTED_B64> b kq - 0 0\<REDACTED_B64> b kq - 0 0\<REDACTED_B64> b kq - 0 0")
print(out)
random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0)
n = 0; t = time.time()
for g in range(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 300):
    b = chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over():
        if b.turn == chess.WHITE:
            check(b.fen()); n += 1
        moves = list(b.legal_moves)
        # bias towards captures/castles/ep/promotions for coverage
        spec = [m for m in moves if b.is_castling(m) or b.is_en_passant(m) or m.promotion]
        b.push(random.choice(spec) if spec and random.random() < 0.7 else random.choice(moves))
print("ok", n, "positions", time.time() - t, "s")
